manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Shows a tossed ball and a dropped ball at the top, illustrating that velocity can be zero while acceleration remains non‑zero.
manifest.description: Two side‑by‑side lanes display a tossed ball and a ball released from rest at the apex. Arrows show velocity and acceleration, a gate releases the second ball, and readouts report their values.
assumptions: No air resistance, same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
